name: Apprentice
note: A stub (#198): their map line as the fallback bark, one ambient group, a two-node conversation. Michael, or a writing session, fills the rest.

lines: Forty bales of wool. Not one sale.
It is all here. Every bale. Nobody to buy it.

say: Mind the stock. It is the merchant's.
Upstairs. Or at the bridge. I have stopped checking.
They said to count it twice. I am on my ninth.
